title: Intel buys AI chip startup Habana Labs for about $2B

sources.quote: We acquired Habana Labs Ltd., an Israel-based developer of programmable deep learning accelerators for the data center, for approximately $1.7 billion.

explain: Intel bought Israeli AI chip startup Habana Labs, maker of the Gaudi AI chips, in December 2019. It was announced as a roughly $2B deal; Intel's annual report puts the net price at about $1.7B, the amount shown.
